recommendations.text: Monitor pest activity, especially fall armyworm and cutworm, and take appropriate control measures.
Adjust irrigation practices based on recent rainfall, ensuring proper drainage and avoiding waterlogging.
Keep an eye on market prices and consider selling sorghum when prices are favorable.
Be aware of the recent above-normal rainfall and its potential impacts on soil and crop health.
